name: PRD completion integrity
description: Multiple related bugs that allowed incomplete PRDs to be archived and new PRDs to be invisible to the scanner. Discovered during Assumptions Manager dogfooding.

userStories.title: Scanner treats missing passes field as incomplete
userStories.description: As a developer, I want PRDs without a passes field on user stories to be treated as incomplete, so that manually created or Claude-generated PRDs without the field are still picked up for work.
acceptanceCriteria: prd_has_incomplete_stories() returns true if any story lacks passes field
count_incomplete_stories() counts stories with passes:false OR missing passes field
count_complete_stories() only counts stories with explicit passes:true
fade status shows PRDs with missing passes fields as having incomplete work

userStories.title: Validate PRD completion before archive
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the archive function to verify the source file has all passes:true before archiving, so that incomplete PRDs cannot be falsely archived.
acceptanceCriteria: archive_completed_prds() re-reads source file immediately before mv
Archive aborts if any story has passes:false or missing passes field
Warning message displayed if archive validation fails
prd_is_fully_complete() requires explicit passes:true on ALL stories

userStories.title: Archive verifies source file deleted after move
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the archive function to verify the source file no longer exists after mv, so that duplicate files cannot exist in both locations.
acceptanceCriteria: After mv command, check source file no longer exists
If source still exists, display error and abort
Archive count only incremented after successful verification

userStories.title: Add PRD integrity rules to prompt.md
userStories.description: As a developer, I want explicit instructions in prompt.md about PRD file handling, so that Claude cannot create modified copies or falsify completion status.
acceptanceCriteria: New 'PRD Integrity Rules' section added to prompt.md
Explicit instruction: NEVER create copies of PRD files
Explicit instruction: ALWAYS update the ORIGINAL file in prds/ or fade/prds/
Explicit instruction: NEVER write directly to prd-archive/
Explicit instruction: Verify passes:true BEFORE signalling completion

userStories.title: Add version stamps to FADE artifacts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want FADE artifacts to include version metadata, so that I can identify version drift between projects and know when to run fade update.
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md includes version comment at top: <!-- FADE vX.X.X -->
FADE.md template includes version comment at top
fade init stamps current version into generated files
fade status --json includes artifact versions
fade update can detect version mismatch
